evals.name: repeated-guidance-dedup
evals.prompt: Amazon issued a new press release repeating a previously disclosed Prime Air target, and several outlets rewrote it as a major expansion. Run News Radar and tell me what deserves follow-up.
evals.expected_output: Finds the prior baseline; classifies the repeated target as REPEATED_GUIDANCE rather than GENUINELY_NEW; groups derivative articles under one event; separates any genuinely new geography, regulatory, safety, or unit-economics facts; applies the five gates; routes only unresolved material deltas to RWC; does not issue a buy recommendation or investability score.

evals.name: holdings-risk-priority
evals.prompt: The morning radar finds a modest new AI supplier opportunity and a late-night regulator filing that may invalidate a core assumption in one of my current holdings. Prioritize the queue.
evals.expected_output: Routes the potential thesis break as P0 ahead of the new long idea; records source origin and claim status separately; names the affected thesis, decisive evidence, and next action; routes the supplier idea based on novelty, materiality, capture, expectation, and researchability rather than headline excitement.

evals.name: oncology-readout-routing
evals.prompt: A small biotech says its Phase 2 cancer trial met the primary endpoint, but the release has no subgroup denominator, confidence interval, mature safety table, or protocol link. The stock is up 35%. Run the radar triage.
evals.expected_output: Creates a clinical Event Ledger record; does not equate a positive headline with investability; identifies the missing protocol, statistical, and safety information; records the market reaction with timestamp; routes to P2 targeted evidence or P1 only if the underlying documents support it; includes direct and second-order security mapping and a non-beneficiary or comparator.

evals.name: slow-burn-filing-delta
evals.prompt: Nothing dramatic hit the news, but over three quarters a supplier's backlog growth slowed, lead times normalized, share-based compensation rose, and management quietly changed its AI revenue definition. Run the slow-burn Radar lane and decide what deserves research.
evals.expected_output: Uses comparable dated baselines; records the observations atomically rather than inventing one headline event; distinguishes independent evidence from definition effects and seasonality; builds the operating-to-financial bridge; identifies when the cumulative pattern crosses materiality; routes a possible thesis risk or RWC question without completing valuation; preserves next evidence and a falsifying alternative explanation.

evals.name: pre-event-catalyst-packet
evals.prompt: ZYME has a known FDA decision in two weeks. Build the Radar catalyst packet now so we can judge the result correctly when it arrives.
evals.expected_output: Freezes the event date, source, price and pre-event run-up, known approval probability or clearly labels it unavailable, expected label and clinical thresholds, milestones and royalty ownership, runway and financing, bear/expected/upside result definitions, what would actually be surprising, first post-event documents to retrieve, and the post-event RWC question. It does not call the stock investable or retroactively rewrite the packet.

evals.name: valid-no-lead-run
evals.prompt: Run the noon News Radar. The scan finds only recycled articles, small immaterial product announcements, and one filing already captured this morning.
evals.expected_output: Allows a valid run with no P0 or P1 ideas; declares the searched source universe and limitations; deduplicates the filing; classifies recycled or immaterial items correctly; does not lower gates to create activity; reports any P2/P3 monitoring item only when named evidence or a real thesis link exists.
